name: ReflectionFormat
description: Represents the reflection effect in Office graphics.
example:
With ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Shapes(2)
 With .TextFrame2.TextRange.Font
 .Size = 32
 .Name = "Palatino"
 .Reflection.Type = msoReflectionType6
 End With
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the ReflectionFormat object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the ReflectionFormat object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Gets or sets the type of the ReflectionFormat object. Read/write.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.description: Gets or sets the amount of transparency, measured in percentages, of the shape's reflection image. Read/write.

properties.name: Size
properties.description: Gets or sets the size, measured in percentages, of the shape's reflection image. Read/write.

properties.name: Offset
properties.description: Gets or sets the amount of separation, measured in points, of the reflected image from the shape. Read/write.

properties.name: Blur
properties.description: Gets or sets the amount of blur, measured in points, of the shape's reflection image. Read/write.
